scripts.check: bun check --no-script assets/js/ && bun fmt --check . && hugo --minify --gc --panicOnWarning
scripts.dev: bun build assets/js/index.ts --outfile static/js/index.js && (trap 'kill 0' EXIT; bun build assets/js/index.ts --watch --outfile static/js/index.js & hugo server --disableFastRender --navigateToChanged)
